title: Bounded Multi-Site health history, trend and acknowledgement reads
opportunity: Individual health history and trend endpoints, plus the acknowledgement read phase, had no database time budget even though the summary endpoint was bounded.
rootCause: The endpoints passed the request cancellation token directly to SiteDatabaseStore reads and only returned when the caller disconnected or the database completed.
implementation: Added a two-second linked SiteHealthReadBudget with explicit client-cancellation distinction.
Applied the budget to health history, trend and acknowledgement discovery reads.
Returned the bounded site_health_read_timeout ProblemDetails response and localized its recovery copy in the browser.

tdd.red: SiteHealthReadBudgetTests initially failed to compile because the budget policy did not exist; the endpoint contract then required all three read paths to use it.

verification.impeccableDetector: passed with four pre-existing advisory color findings (#ff4d5e, #22374f, #ff6378); no new finding
verification.uiAuditBoundary: one localized error-copy addition; no CSS/HTML visual assets changed; existing UI audit baseline retained

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL slow-read execution, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive verification, full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified.
